cognitive-complexity-rule.desc: Verifies that every function has a SonarQube cognitive complexity score below a maximum.

config.item: max - maximum cognitive complexity allowed per function (default 8).
ignore - list of functions to skip. A file path followed by `::` and the function or `Type::method` (e.g. `src/main.rs::run`, `src/main.rs::Config::new`)

cognitive-complexity-rule.report: Supports `--report`: prints the distribution of scores across the codebase.
